answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, clawed back after a replayed submission, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the bridge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Each submission hangs on the marble of a task receipt, and the river is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
